description_en: Queries the list of triggers for a specified function
description_zh: 查询指定函数的触发器列表
kebab_example: aliyun fc-open list-triggers --service-name demo-service --function-name demo-function --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTriggers

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of resources to return. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 20. The maximum value is 100. The number of returned results may be less than the specified value but never exceeds it
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve more results. You do not need to provide this parameter for the first query. The token for subsequent queries is obtained from the returned results
parameters.help_zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的token从返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The prefix that the names of returned resources must start with
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回的资源名称必须以prefix作为前缀
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en: Specifies that the results are returned in alphabetical order starting from the value of startKey (inclusive)
parameters.help_zh: 设定结果从startKey之后（包括startKey）按字母排序的第一个开始返回
parameters.name: start_key

parameters.help_zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: x_fc_account_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the client initiated the request. The format is EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.help_zh: 客户端发起请求的时间。格式为EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT
parameters.name: x_fc_date

triggerConfig.description_en:
The trigger configuration. The configuration varies based on the trigger type. For more information, see the following data structures:

OSS trigger: See [OSSTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html）.
Simple Log Service trigger: See [LogTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html）.
Timer trigger: See [TimeTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html）.
HTTP trigger: See [HTTPTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html）.
Tablestore trigger: You only need to specify the complete SourceArn parameter. No additional configuration is required. Set this parameter to an empty object {}.
CDN event trigger: See [CDNEventsTriggerConfig](~~struct:CDNEventsTriggerConfig~~).
MNS topic trigger: See [MnsTopicTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html）.
EventBridge trigger: See [EventBridgeTriggerConfig](~~struct:EventBridgeTriggerConfig~~)
triggerConfig.description_zh:
触发器配置，针对不同类型的触发器，配置有所不同。具体格式请参考如下对应的数据结构：

OSS触发器：请参见[OSSTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415697.html）。
日志服务触发器：请参见[LogTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415694.html）。
定时触发器：请参见[TimeTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415712.html）。
HTTP触发器：请参见[HTTPTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415685.html）。
Tablestore触发器：只需要填写完整的SourceArn参数便可, 这里无需额外配置，取值为空{}。
CDN事件触发器：请参见[CDNEventsTriggerConfig](~~struct:CDNEventsTriggerConfig~~)。
MNS主题触发器：请参见[MnsTopicTriggerConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/415695.html）。
EventBridge触发器：请参见[EventBridgeTriggerConfig](~~struct:EventBridgeTriggerConfig~~)
